pages.text: Normal chests on a moving contraption are simple. These mods make them smarter. The $(thing)Create integration$() add-ons make Sophisticated Backpacks and Storage work fully on contraptions. $(thing)Smarter Contraption Storage$() lets you control which containers take items.

pages.title: Sophisticated Storage on Contraptions
pages.text: Both add-ons describe themselves as full-featured Sophisticated storage on Create contraptions. Chests, barrels and backpacks can ride along with their upgrades.

pages.title: Smarter Contraption Storage
pages.text: A Contraption Controls block can switch containers on or off. One block can control many neighbouring chests. A switched-off chest is left out of the contraption.

Items picked up by contraption actors go into available containers automatically. Any actor can use them.$(br2)A Toolbox on a contraption can refill the hotbar of nearby players from the stored items.$(br2)See $(l:create_basics/contraptions)Contraptions$(/l).
